title: Reentrancy (SWC-107)
text: External call (call/transfer/token hook) before state update lets the callee re-enter. Variants: single-function, cross-function, cross-contract, read-only reentrancy (view returns stale state mid-callback). Fix: checks-effects-interactions, nonReentrant, pull payments.

title: Access control / authorization
text: Missing owner/role checks on mutators (mint, upgrade, withdraw-all, pause, setConfig); tx.origin auth; unprotected initializer; default-public functions. Fix: role modifiers on msg.sender, initializer guards.

title: Arithmetic & precision
text: Unchecked over/underflow, unsafe casts, rounding toward the user, divide-before-multiply, first-depositor share inflation in ERC4626 vaults, donation attacks. Fix: checked math, round against user, virtual shares/offset.

title: Proxy & upgradeability
text: UUPS/transparent/beacon/diamond: uninitialized implementation (self-destruct/reinit), storage-slot collisions between proxy and logic, unprotected upgradeTo, missing initializer modifier, function-selector clashes (transparent), __gap omissions. Fix: EIP-1967 slots, disableInitializers in constructor, storage gaps, onlyProxy.

title: delegatecall & code injection
text: delegatecall to attacker-influenced target runs code in this storage/balance context; library delegatecall self-destruct; msg.value/msg.sender preservation pitfalls. Fix: fixed trusted targets, no user-controlled delegatecall.

title: Oracle & price manipulation
text: Spot price from AMM reserves (flash-loanable), stale Chainlink (no heartbeat/answeredInRound/minAnswer checks), single-source, L2 sequencer-uptime feed ignored. Fix: TWAP, staleness+deviation checks, multiple sources.

title: Flash-loan economic attacks
text: Atomic borrowed liquidity distorts a mid-tx assumption (price, totalSupply, voting power, collateral ratio) to bypass solvency/governance/liquidation. Fix: don''t trust same-block spot state; snapshots; block-delayed governance.

title: Liquidation & accounting
text: Bad-debt from rounding, liquidation bypass via rounding/min-amounts, cascade/insolvency under extreme moves, incentive mispricing, fee-on-transfer/rebasing token accounting breaks. Fix: conservative rounding, health-factor invariants, handle non-standard tokens.

title: MEV — front-running & sandwich
text: Public mempool lets searchers reorder/insert txs: sandwich swaps lacking slippage/minOut/deadline, front-run approvals/commit-reveal, oracle-update front-running, NFT-mint sniping. Fix: slippage + deadline, commit-reveal, private mempool, batch auctions.

title: MEV — JIT, censorship, reordering
text: Just-in-time liquidity around large swaps, proposer/builder censorship of liquidations, time-bandit reorgs on high-value state, backrunning. Fix: minimize same-block value extraction, TWAP-settled auctions, finality-aware logic.

title: Bridges — message verification
text: Cross-chain messaging flaws: forged/unverified proofs, missing source-chain + nonce + domain binding, trusting an unauthenticated relayer/validator set, insufficient finality (reorg double-spend), mint/lock accounting mismatch. Fix: verify message origin+nonce+finality, strict replay protection, threshold validation.

title: Bridges — replay & cross-domain
text: Replay of a message on multiple destinations, cross-domain-sender spoofing (xDomainMessageSender), re-entrant message execution, upgradeable bridge admin takeover. Fix: per-message nonce+chainId, authenticated cross-domain sender, execution guards.

title: L2 rollups — optimistic
text: Fraud-proof window bypass, data-availability gaps, forced-inclusion censorship, withdrawal finalization before challenge, sequencer downtime/front-running, L1->L2 message replay. Fix: honest challenge incentives, DA guarantees, finalization delays, sequencer-uptime checks.

title: L2 rollups — ZK / validity
text: Soundness bugs in the validity proof/verifier, public-input mismatch, trusted-setup compromise, recursion/aggregation flaws, bridge trusting an invalid proof. Fix: audited verifier, correct public-input binding, ceremony transparency.

title: Signatures — ECDSA & EIP-712
text: ecrecover returns address(0) on bad sig (treat as auth bypass), signature malleability (high-s), missing nonce (replay), missing chainId/verifyingContract (cross-chain/contract replay), signed-struct type confusion. Fix: EIP-712 domain, nonce, reject malleable s, check recovered != 0.

title: Hashing, Merkle & commitments
text: abi.encodePacked hash collisions with multiple dynamic args, second-preimage/duplicate-leaf in Merkle airdrops, predictable commitments, keccak of user-controlled layout. Fix: abi.encode or length-prefix, domain-separate leaves, salted commit-reveal.

title: ZK verification flows
text: On-chain verifier accepting malformed/forged proofs, missing public-input checks, unconstrained signals in the circuit, nullifier reuse (double-spend) in mixers. Fix: bind all public inputs, verified circuits, nullifier sets.

title: Governance & timelocks
text: Flash-loan / delegated voting-power acquisition, snapshot-at-execution instead of proposal, missing/too-short timelock, low proposal threshold, privileged config/impl change without delay, emergency-admin abuse. Fix: snapshot at proposal, enforce timelock, bound admin power.

title: Weak randomness
text: block.timestamp/number/prevrandao/blockhash are predictable or influenceable; lottery/NFT-trait/matchmaking abuse. Fix: commit-reveal or VRF (Chainlink VRF) with proper request/fulfill handling.

title: Non-standard ERC20 behavior
text: Missing-return tokens (USDT), fee-on-transfer, rebasing, double-entrypoint, reentrant ERC777/ERC721 hooks, infinite-approval phishing. Fix: SafeERC20, measure balance deltas, handle hooks, reentrancy guards.

title: Denial of service
text: Unbounded loops over user-growable arrays, gas-griefing via external call in a loop, push-payment to a reverting receiver, storage-pointer bricking, block-gas-limit batch failures. Fix: pull payments, bounded iteration, isolate external calls.

title: Compiler & optimizer security
text: Optimizer miscompilation (historical Yul/SMTChecker bugs), via-IR vs legacy behavioral differences, ABI head/tail decoding of malicious calldata, inline-assembly memory-safety, dirty high bits. Differential testing across solc versions surfaces these. Fix: pin audited solc, differential test, avoid risky assembly.

title: EVM execution semantics
text: call vs staticcall vs delegatecall context, gas-stipend assumptions (2300 breaks post-Istanbul), returndatasize/returndatacopy, precompile edge cases, create2 address reuse after selfdestruct, SELFDESTRUCT semantics changes, transient storage (EIP-1153) misuse. Fix: don''t rely on gas stipends, validate call results, careful create2.

title: Clients, consensus & RPC
text: Execution/consensus-client interaction: reorg handling of confirmations, finality assumptions, mempool visibility (MEV), RPC exposure (unauthenticated admin/debug namespaces, eth_sendTransaction on a node with unlocked accounts), trace/archive dependence, rate-limit/DoS. For dApps: require sufficient confirmations/finality, never expose admin RPC, validate against reorgs.

title: Economic & incentive security
text: Ponzi/last-actor dynamics, reward-emission inflation, fee-capture, griefing where attacker pays little to cost others much, MEV redistribution, collateral/incentive mispricing enabling risk-free profit. Analyze with game theory + invariant fuzzing over the accounting model.

title: Formal methods & invariants
text: Express protocol invariants (sum(balances)==totalSupply, solvency: assets>=liabilities, monotonic accounting) and check with symbolic execution (Halmos/Mythril) and invariant fuzzing (Echidna/Medusa). A violated invariant with a concrete counterexample is strong evidence.
